# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Deep tide teal (#0F3D3E) for text and primary buttons, foam white (#F6F8F5) for backgrounds, sand (#E9E2D0) for alternating bands, coral (#E8705A) for a single accent per section.
- **Type:** Fraunces (semi-bold) for headings, Inter for body and UI labels. Body at 18px with 1.6 line height.
- **Imagery:** Warm, candid photos of 3–6 person teams at a shared table, desaturated slightly to match the palette. Use thin, hand-drawn wave lines as dividers.
- **Voice:** Calm, specific, plainspoken. Short sentences, no jargon.

**Sections, top to bottom**

1. **Header:** Logo left, three links (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Start free" button right. Transparent over the hero, solid foam white on scroll.

2. **Hero:** Two columns. Left: headline "Plan your week together, before Monday starts." Subhead names the pain: "Tidepool gives small teams one shared view of who's doing what, and when." Primary CTA "Start planning free," secondary "See how it works." Right: a product screenshot of the week board, tilted slightly, with a coral sticky note reading "Ship the pricing draft, Thu."

3. **Trust strip:** Single row of five to six customer logos in grayscale on sand. Caption: "Used by teams of 2 to 12."

4. **Problem:** Centered, narrow column. Headline: "Most weeks start with a 20-minute scramble." Three short lines describing the Monday ritual (who's free, what's blocked, what did we agree on). Copy stays concrete and a little wry.

5. **How it works:** Three numbered columns on foam white. Each has a small line illustration and a verb-led title: "Add the week's work," "Assign it to a person," "Check in with a glance." Each body is two sentences maximum.

6. **Feature spotlight:** Full-width sand band, image left, text right. Headline "One board, everyone's week." Describe the shared timeline with capacity shown per person. Include a single pull quote from a customer in Fraunces italic.

7. **Rhythm section:** Reverse layout. Covers async standups and Friday recaps. Headline "Less meeting, same alignment." Show a mock recap card as the visual.

8. **Pricing teaser:** Centered. Two tiers only (Free for up to 5 people, Team at a flat per-team rate). Headline states the price logic plainly. Link to full pricing page.

9. **FAQ:** Accordion, five to six questions. Cover: team size limits, integrations, data export, who can see what, and cancellation.

10. **Final CTA:** Teal full-bleed block with a foam white headline: "Your next Monday can start with a plan." One button, no secondary action. Email field optional.

11. **Footer:** Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal), small wave motif at top, sand background.

# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**What changed and why**
- Adopted the vertical week timeline as a recurring device, used in the hero and feature sections.
- Added a hand-drawn arrow annotation, drawn in the same line style as the wave dividers.
- Kept the hero headline under 12 words. The Library example runs past 40 words, which buries the point.
- Set the pull quote in Fraunces italic rather than monospace. Monospace stays for data labels.
- Coral is now restricted to non-text accents and large display text, since coral on foam white fails contrast at body sizes.

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Tide teal (#0F3D3E) for text and primary buttons, foam white (#F6F8F5) for backgrounds, sand (#E9E2D0) for alternating bands, coral (#E8705A) for accents only.
- **Type:** Fraunces semi-bold for headings and the pull quote, Inter for body and UI, JetBrains Mono for numbers, day labels, and timestamps. Body at 18px, 1.6 line height.
- **Imagery:** Candid photos of 3–6 person teams at a shared table, slightly desaturated. Hand-drawn wave dividers and one hand-drawn arrow per page, never more.
- **Voice:** Calm, specific, plainspoken. Sentences under 15 words where possible.

**Sections, top to bottom**

1. **Header:** Logo left, links (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Start free" button right. Transparent over the hero, solid foam white on scroll. Collapses to a menu icon below 768px.

2. **Hero:** Two columns. Left: headline "Plan your week together, before Monday starts." Subhead: "One shared view of who's doing what, and when, for teams of 2 to 12." CTAs: "Start planning free" (primary), "See how it works" (secondary). Right: product screenshot with a vertical Mon–Fri timeline sidebar, each day a node with a capacity count in mono. A hand-drawn coral arrow runs from the headline to the screenshot. On mobile, the arrow is hidden and the screenshot stacks below the CTAs.

3. **Trust strip:** Five or six grayscale logos on sand. Caption: "Used by teams of 2 to 12." Add one proof number beside it, such as "4,800 Monday plans made last month," once it's real.

4. **Problem:** Centered, narrow column. Headline: "Most weeks start with a 20-minute scramble." Three lines on the Monday ritual: who's free, what's blocked, what we agreed on. Close with a single line: "Tidepool answers all three before the first message goes out."

5. **How it works:** Three columns on foam white, each with a line illustration and a verb-led title. Each body is two sentences maximum. The timeline sidebar appears in column one to show the add-work step.

6. **Feature spotlight:** Full-width sand band. Image left, text right. Headline "One board, everyone's week." The shared timeline with per-person capacity bars. Pull quote from a customer in Fraunces italic, attributed with role and team size in mono.

7. **Rhythm section:** Reversed layout. Headline "Less meeting, same alignment." Visual is a mock Friday recap card with a timestamp in mono. Include a link: "See a sample recap."

8. **Pricing teaser:** Centered. Two tiers: Free up to 5 people, Team at a flat per-team rate. Headline states the price logic in one sentence, with the actual rate. Link to the full pricing page.

9. **FAQ:** Accordion of five to six questions: team size limits, integrations, data export, who sees what, cancellation, and "Does it replace our calendar?"

10. **Final CTA:** Teal full-bleed block. Headline: "Your next Monday can start with a plan." One button, no secondary action. Optional email field.

11. **Footer:** Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal). Wave motif at top, sand background.
